title: Working dogs..  But with more!
description: This adds working dogs, But not just that! It also adds other aspects like more foods to make, more biomes etc
body: This mod adds working dogs, more foods to try, lots of more biomes and more why not try it! some of the stuff includes: lots of cooking you can make apple pies, soups, and even more cakes then just one! You can even visit biomes such as lavender fields, volcanos and even more!! Oh don't forget space, with the Ad Astra mod you can even visit space:3
